label: The Nine Rivers
summary: A land of martial sects, wandering swordsmen and old grudges, where a stolen technique manual can start a war.

world.era: An age of sects and wandering heroes
world.setting: The Nine Rivers, a land of misty mountains, river towns and rival martial sects
world.description: The great martial sects of the Nine Rivers keep the peace, more or less, through tournaments, marriages and very long memories. Masters can run across rooftops and cut a falling leaf in three. Each sect guards its secret techniques in a manual, and a stolen manual is reason enough for a feud that lasts a generation.
rules: Martial arts are near-magical; qi lets masters do the impossible
Honor, loyalty and debts of gratitude bind everyone
Teahouses and inns are where news, challenges and trouble start
Fights are graceful and fast; the clever fighter beats the strong one

narration.tone: Graceful and fierce, with honor and old grudges
